item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Game Mode and exclusive full screen for Windows games: 30-55 to 90-115 FPS in Brawlhalla on an M2 Pro, less input lag.
  • Epic Games and GOG without their launchers.
  • Electron installers (Notion, Discord, Slack) now install and run.
  • Frame rate cap and MetalFX upscaling per program.
  • Quick Look icons for .exe files, Shortcuts actions, controller tester, Whisky import, save backups.
